name: East Wing Foyer
narrativeOnEnter: The heavy doors seal behind you with a magnetic thud. Emergency lighting — a dim, sickly amber — casts long shadows across the cracked tile floor. The reception desk is overturned. Somewhere deep in the building, something shifts.

hotspots.label: Corridor Gate
hotspots.lockedMessage: A heavy iron gate. Locked. There must be a key somewhere in this room.

hotspots.label: Front Entrance
hotspots.lockedMessage: The magnetic lock is engaged. You need the master key to disengage it.

action.text:
BLACKWOOD PSYCHIATRIC INSTITUTE
Patient Intake Register — East Wing

Admissions are listed by patient number.
Patient 04, Patient 07, Patient 11...

Last entry: Patient 07. Admitted: March, 1972.
Status: ONGOING. Ward B assignment.

A handwritten note in the margin:
'Ward B gate — use service key from desk.'

───
Patient 07's entry has been circled in red ink.
In the margin beside it, very small — almost invisible unless you know to look:

'Δ — AXIOM CANDIDATE — CONFIRMED.
Neural map session scheduled: 14 March.
See HELIOS Phase 1 intake protocol.'

Δ. The same symbol appears beside six other entries. Seven circles. Seven names.
All from Ward B.
All 1972.

INTERNAL MEMO — DR. HARLAN, DIRECTOR

Following the incident in Ward B, all personnel are reminded:

— Records vault access requires power from the treatment room.
— Director's office remains locked. Key issued to records staff only.
— Chapel remains open to patients per therapeutic protocol.

Do NOT discuss Ward B with visitors.

— Administration, 1972

───
Pinned over the memo, handwritten on a torn sheet:

'Patient 07 has left the facility.
Do NOT report to police. Do NOT contact family.
Notify AXIOM Group contact at the number below.
Say only: "The package was opened early."
— H'

───
Behind the memo, half-hidden — a printed document:

AXIOM GROUP — PROJECT HELIOS — PHASE 1 DIRECTIVE

'Blackwood Psychiatric Institute (contracted facility)
has been authorised to collect neural mapping data
from consenting participants under the designation
"Therapeutic EEG Protocol, Series B."

All data collected is property of AXIOM Group LLC.
Facility staff are reminded: participants must not
be informed of the commercial application.
Confidentiality is a condition of the facility contract.

— AXIOM Research Division, January 1972'

A wall-mounted intercom unit. The speaker grille is cracked. When you press the button, nothing happens — no power, no signal.

Someone has scratched four digits into the metal casing: 4-0-3-1.

You're not sure what they mean.

BLACKWOOD PSYCHIATRIC INSTITUTE
East Wing Floor Plan

Ground Floor:
  → Reception / Foyer [YOU ARE HERE]
  → Patient Corridor — Ward A & Ward B
  → Chapel (East End)

Ward B (Gate-Locked):
  → Nurses' Station
  → Treatment Room
  → Records Vault (requires power)

Director's Office — Second Floor
  Access via Records Vault only.
